entries.german:
Ritter Konrad von Rosenberg und seine Frau Margarethe von Seinsheim ("Suonß-"), Frau zu Schwarzenberg, quittieren Hans von Helmstatt und seiner Frau Anna Landschad über 2000 fl Zugeld [zum Heiratsvertrag] für deren Tochter Margarethe und ihren eigenen Sohn Erasmus.Siegler: Konrad von Rosenberg

Laufzeit: 1451 (1451 Febr 21 - So v cathedra Petri)
entries.english:
Knight Konrad von Rosenberg and his wife Margaretha von Seinsheim zu Schwarzenberg acknowledge receipt from Hans von Helmstatt and his wife Anna Landschad of 2,000 guilders as the marriage payment for their daughter Margaretha von Helmstatt and their own son Erasmus von Rosenberg.
Sealer: Konrad von Rosenberg

Period: 1451 (February 21, 1451 - Sunday before Cathedra Petri)

facts.content: and his wife Margarethe von Seinsheim acknowledged receipt from Hans von Helmstatt and Anna Landschad of 2,000 florins in marriage payment for their daughter Margarethe and Konrad’s son Erasmus.
